640-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
640-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
640-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Dross Harvester and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1580-3845-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-3845-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3234-3293-3899-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3899-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3899-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-4823-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-4823-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Timeless Witness without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Timeless Witness spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Timeless Witness) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-4823-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

2556-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Mnemonic Wall.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Mnemonic Wall from exile to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1766-1978-7714.description:
Cast Thran Dynamo by paying its mana cost.
When Thran Dynamo enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Thran Dynamo that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Thran Dynamo token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Thran Dynamo token.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3043-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-4927.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

423-1313-1437-5621.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-5621.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

628-2511-7200.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

3713-5078-6006-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3713-5078-6006-6650.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2341-2495-3941.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Coveted Jewel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Coveted Jewel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Coveted Jewel and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

1369-4137-7086.description:
Cast Touch of Vitae by paying {2}{G}, targeting Blossom-Clad Werewolf.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental by paying {U}, causing it to gain Blossom-Clad Werewolf's activated abilities until end of turn.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Blossom-Clad Werewolf's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Quicksilver Elemental using Blossom-Clad Werewolf's ability granted to it by Touch of Vitae by paying {0}, untapping Quicksilver Elemental.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2921-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1170-3375-5078-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-3375-5078-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-5220-5477-6753-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-5220-5477-6753-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating two creature tokens and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2781-3835-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1681-2438-4140.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd.
When Twilight Shepherd dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Giada.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1818-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

678-5686-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
678-5686-6749.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Anticausal Vestige.
When Anticausal Vestige dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, causing you to return Anticausal Vestige from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Anticausal Vestige trigger, causing you to reveal the top cards of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise, and then put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1268-1305-4417-6674.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
974-1268-1305-4417-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{U}{B}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.

1355-3750.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five enchantments.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
1355-3750.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control six or more enchantments and/or control another creature that can tap to produce mana, this combo nets infinite mana.

3259-3480-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-3480-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1456-4030-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

450-1218-1819.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
450-1218-1819.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten Spirit creature cards in your library.
450-1218-1819.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Iname from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{B}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Iname enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to search your library for at least ten Spirit creature cards and put them into your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that was put into your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1978-2625-3263-4659-4768.notablePrerequisites: Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
1978-2625-3263-4659-4768.description:
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
When the Banana enters the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Banana, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat.

112-2114-3258.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara's Oathsworn does not have summoning sickness and has exactly three +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ayara's Oathsworn.
112-2114-3258.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ayara's Oathsworn.
Ayara's Oathsworn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Ayara's Oathsworn and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

730-1479-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

774-3147-4826.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Azorius Chancery for {W}{U}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Azorius Chancery to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-2567-4283.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other additional creatures and at least three lands.
An additional creature in your graveyard or on the battlefield under your control.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2567-4283.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing two other creatures, returning Avenger of Zendikar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating at least three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Whisper by tapping it and sacrificing Avenger of Zendikar and a Plant token, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1368-3518-4856.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard.
1368-3518-4856.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling three cards besides Brain Freeze from your graveyard.
Cast Brain Freeze from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Brain Freeze's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Brain Freeze targeting yourself, and any remaining copies targeting an opponent.
Resolve each Brain Freeze, causing yourself to mill six cards and, if applicable, an opponent to mill three cards for each Brain Freeze remaining.
Repeat.

168-2210-4753-4768.description:
Cast Mirrormade by paying {2}{U}.
Mirrormade enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Mirrormade's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring.
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield as a copy of the Oblivion Ring copy, triggering Altar of the Brood and itself.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator's trigger, exiling Mirrormade.
Mirrormade leaves the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Altar of the Brood and Oblivion Ring trigger.
Resolve the Altar of Brood trigger, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator leaves the battlefield, returning Mirrormade from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until each opponent has an empty library, then end the loop by choosing to copy or exile any other permanent.

1806-2034-2393-4666.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void and Sifter of Skulls triggers.
Resolve the Planar Void trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2334-2493-3617.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat

478-1846-3911-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Islands.
478-1846-3911-4235.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}, causing all Islands to add an additional {U} when they are tapped for mana this turn.
Activate two Islands you control by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Candelabra of Tawnos' ability.
Resolve the first Candelabra of Tawnos ability, untapping the two Islands.
Activate two Islands you control by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Resolve the second Candelabra of Tawnos ability, untapping the two Islands.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Galvanic Key's ability.
Resolve both Galvanic Key abilities, untapping Galvanic Key and Candelabra of Tawnos.
Repeat from step 2.
